title: Muxed-contract strkey from contract ID and ID 2^63 equals the SEP-0023 test vector
why: In XDR the 64-bit ID comes before the key in MuxedEd25519Account and MuxedContract, while the SEP-0023 strkey payload puts the key first; code that copies bytes between the two forms instead of converting field by field produces a valid-looking address for another key and ID.
notes: Built by xdrcheck-corpus synth from corpus/recipes/cap-0084/api-muxed-address-field-order.9e1.json. Origin: probe vector 9E1, in evidence/sdk-matrix/vectors/vectors.json, executed in every probe column (evidence/sdk-matrix). Payload = contract ID || ID (2^63, big-endian), the SEP-0023 v1.4.0 muxed-contract test vector; the text is its SEP-0023 encoding (version byte W). Expected values were computed from the XDR definitions, the CAP or SEP text and the stellar-core rule cited under related, with an independent encoder; no SDK output was used.
